evals.prompt: yo my node app keeps crashing with 'JavaScriptHeapOutOfMemory' error whenever I run a big csv import, like a 2gb file. some coworker said i need to 'stream' it but idk what that means, can you just explain what's going on and what streaming even means
evals.expected_output: A plain-language explanation of why loading a 2GB file into memory at once causes a heap-out-of-memory crash, and what streaming means (processing the file in small chunks instead of loading it all at once) — in full simple sentences, no unexplained jargon, no fragments.
assertions: Explains why loading a 2GB file into memory at once causes a heap-out-of-memory crash
Explains what streaming means in plain language (processing the file in small pieces instead of all at once)
Uses full grammatical sentences throughout, not sentence fragments

Does not use technical jargon (e.g. backpressure, buffer, chunking) without immediately explaining it in plain words
Keeps the exact error string 'JavaScriptHeapOutOfMemory' unaltered if it appears in the answer
